crataegus.definition:
n. A genus of small, hardy trees, including the hawthorn,
   much used for ornamental purposes.

crataegus monogyna.translation: [网络] 山楂属植物；单子山楂；英国山楂

crataegus oxyacantha.translation: [网络] 锐刺山楂；英国山楂；英国山楂花粉

crataegus pinnatifida bge..translation: [医] 北山楂, 大果山楂

cratch.definition: n. A manger or open frame for hay; a crib; a rack.

crate.definition:
n. a rugged box (usually made of wood); used for shipping
n. the quantity contained in a crate
v. put into a crate; as for protection
crate.translation:
n. 板条箱, 装货箱
[建] 篓, 筐

crated.definition: v put into a crate; as for protection
crated.translation: v. 把…装入箱中( crate的过去式 )

crater.definition:
n. a faint constellation in the southern hemisphere near Hydra and Corvus
n. a bowl-shaped depression formed by the impact of a meteorite or bomb
crater.translation:
n. 火山口, 环行山, 弹坑
[化] 焊口; 火山石; 弧坑; 焰口

crater lake.translation: n. 火山口形成的深湖

cratered.translation:
a. 有坑洞的, 多坑的
v. 火山口( crater的过去分词 ); 弹坑等

crateriform.definition:
a. Having the form of a shallow bowl; -- said of a
   corolla.
crateriform.translation:
a. 火山口状的, 漏斗状的, 似火山口的
[医] 杯状的, 火山口状的

cratering.translation: 缩孔(露底), 陷穴(漆病), 磨顶槽

craterlet.translation: n. 小坑洞, 小火山口

craterous.definition: a. Pertaining to, or resembling, a crater.

craters.definition:
n. a bowl-shaped geological formation at the top of a volcano
n. a faint constellation in the southern hemisphere near Hydra and Corvus
n. a bowl-shaped depression formed by the impact of a meteorite or bomb
craters.translation: n. 火山口( crater的复数形式 ); 弹坑等

crates.definition:
n a rugged box (usually made of wood); used for shipping
n the quantity contained in a crate
v put into a crate; as for protection
crates.translation: n. 板条箱, 柳条箱( crate的名词复数 ); 装货箱; 一箱（之量）; 破旧的汽车[飞机]

crateva.translation: [网络] 鱼木属；沙梨木；树头菜

crating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Crate
crating.translation: v. 把…装入箱中( crate的现在分词 )

craton.definition: n the part of a continent that is stable and forms the central mass of the continent; typically Precambrian

cratonic.translation: a. 有克拉通盆地特征的, 指具有厚层刚性大陆地壳（或岩石圈）、长期保持相对稳定、较少遭受变形的广大区域

cratons.definition:
plural of craton
n the part of a continent that is stable and forms the central mass of the continent; typically Precambrian
cratons.translation: (craton 的复数) n.[地]克拉通,稳定地块
